summary: Comments, docs and test fixtures no longer name real hosts; the perf slot is taken automatically on a host marked by ~/.config/fractal/perf-slot instead of one named host, and the Namespace usage report tells local runners by a neutral name pattern.

replay.detail: No stored data is read or written differently.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or fleet coordination version change.

compatibility.detail: Outside CI, scripts/ci-perf load and load-hog take the perf slot by themselves only when ~/.config/fractal/perf-slot exists; no host takes the slot automatically until a marker exists. scripts/ci-namespace-usage counts runners named HOST-ci-N or HOST-ci-merge-N as local, as before for the build host's runners.

manual.detail: On the host whose load runs share one machine, create the marker: mkdir -p ~/.config/fractal && touch ~/.config/fractal/perf-slot. Until then a load run there does not wait for another; take the slot by hand with scripts/ci-perf-slot -- COMMAND.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit; the slot is again taken by hostname.
